entity_raw.definition_raw:
You have trained with lizardfolk and learned their ways.

Prerequisite(s): Str 13

Benefit(s): You gain a +2 bonus on Swim checks. If you have 10 or more ranks in Swim, the bonus increases to +4. This bonus doubles while you’re in marshy terrain. In addition, you can move normally into squares with a shallow bog, and it costs you only 2 squares of movement to move into a square with a deep bog.
